2nd.authority: PRIMARY printed folio scan (2nd Ed) NapoleonatWaterloo.pdf p.5; Oliver module map restoration used as an independent second witness only

numbering.scheme: OURS — the printed 2nd Ed map carries NO hex numbers (discrepancy D11)
numbering.definition: CCRR, columns 01..27 west to east, rows 01..22 north to south within each column
numbering.anchor: 0101 = the north-westernmost hex of the field; it carries an exit arrow
numbering.parity: ODD columns sit half a hex LOWER than even columns (inverse of the printed 3rd Ed convention — do not cross the two)

extent.note: every column has 22 rows; the north and south edges are jagged by half a hex

2nd.exit_note: eleven arrowed hexes, columns 01-11 of row 01; read off the folio, columns 12+ of row 01 carry no arrow

terrain_classes.clear: 1 MP, no combat effect (roads give no movement or combat benefit in this game)
terrain_classes.town: 1 MP, printed TEC doubles the defender
terrain_classes.woods: ENTRY PROHIBITED; artillery may not fire over
terrain_classes.woods_road: 1 MP, defender doubles per printed TEC; may be entered and left ONLY along the road hexsides listed

woods_road_rejected.1918: N-side hit is the Plancenoit building block in 1917, not a road (zoom p3_chk_1918)
woods_road_rejected.2401: NW/NE hits are the printed words BRITISH/PRUSSIAN PLAYER crossing the hexsides (zoom p3_chk_2401)
woods_road_rejected.2604: SE hit is the Ohain building block in 2704, not a road (zoom p3_chk_2604)

2nd.road_layer_status: ADVISORY ONLY — road_detected is machine-detected and carries false positives from printed text, the compass rose and building blocks. Roads have no movement or combat effect in this edition; the only play-relevant roads are road_sides on woods_road hexes, which were verified by eye one hex at a time.

at_start_pictures.status: VERIFIED in PREP-4 by three independent witnesses (folio p.4 counter photograph, Oliver ed2 module buildFile+Beginning Setup.vsav, and a re-crop of the primary folio map). Hexes and sides were already verified in PREP-3; the strength readings are now multi-witness and the PROVISIONAL flag is lifted. See corrections_prep4 below and literature/napoleon-at-waterloo/COUNTERS_OOB_VERIFIED.md section 3.
at_start_pictures.side_rule: printed orientation gives the owner: upside-down (printed for the player at the north edge) = Allied, upright = French; corroborated by the printed Front Line, Allied north / French south

corrections_prep4.classification: OUR TRANSCRIPTION ERROR (PREP-3 misread) - explicitly NOT a source defect; the printed map and the printed counter set agree with each other once corrected
corrections_prep4.authority: primary folio re-crop of each disputed hex, rotated 180 (Allied pictures are printed for the player at the north edge), agreeing with both the p.4 counter photograph and the module witness
corrections_prep4.effect: Allied at-start combat-strength total moves 72 -> 73, making the Allied multiset an exact match to the counter photograph and to the module roster.

3rd.authority: MODULE ART ONLY — davejm module map. We hold no printed 3rd Ed map or TEC. Grid and hex numbering are machine-verified against the numbers printed on that art; terrain and exits are module-derived and are NOT a printed-source read.

numbering.parity: EVEN columns sit half a hex lower than odd columns
numbering.verification: OCR of the printed number in every hex of the field: 332 exact and 369 legible of 380 cells; the misses are truncated leading zeros plus hexes whose number is covered by map art. Off-field probes (row 18, and row 17 of every even column) came back blank, which is how the extent was measured.

3rd.geometry: flat-top; dy/dx = 1.1516; declared HexGrid dx=243.9 dy=281.7

extent.note: odd columns run 01..17, even columns 01..16 — proven by OCR: every even column's row 17 probe is blank

3rd.exit_note: nine arrowed hexes, columns 01-09 of row 01, under the legend 'To Waterloo'; 1001 and 1101 are woods and carry no arrow. MODULE ART, not printed source.
3rd.terrain_status: BLOCKED — E14/E15: the printed 3rd Ed rules never state defence doubling or artillery LOS blocking, and we hold no printed 3rd Ed TEC. Nothing here may be promoted to encoded terrain until that chart is obtained.

edition_comparison.extent: 2nd Ed 27x22 = 594 hexes; 3rd Ed 23x(17/16) = 380 hexes. The 3rd Ed map is a SMALLER battlefield, not a renumbering of the same field — this closes E36 with numbers.
edition_comparison.exits: 2nd Ed 11 exit hexes, 3rd Ed 9 — E41 closed per edition, the 3rd Ed's from module art.
edition_comparison.numbering_parity: the two editions' column parities are opposite; a shared hex-id helper would silently mis-stagger one of them.
